text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"(Why is this happening? I'm completely 
focused— 
and yet, everything up until now 
keeps flashing through my mind...)"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"(I lost confidence before the 
overwhelming grandeur of the city... 
but Trainer's guidance helped me get it 
back.)"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"(Even when the world faced terrible 
hardship... 
we kept moving forward, never stopping.)"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"(Every step we took along the way. 
Like bonfires kindling in the dark... 
they rise before my eyes.)"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"—Please, let this run 
remain in everyone's hearts."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"May the life burned upon this turf... 
become a guiding light...!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"It blooms, it blooms, the Triple Tiara 
flower has bloomed! 
Daring Tact 
has claimed the Undefeated Triple 
Tiara...!"

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"To achieve it undefeated is an 
unprecedented historic feat! 
The horsegirl carrying Hidaka's pride has 
etched her name into history!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A title belonging solely to Daring Tact. 
A pure white badge of honor, 
unmarred by a single defeat—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (Clap, clap...!!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"It blooms, it blooms, the Triple Tiara 
flower has bloomed! 
Ushered in by long-awaited applause...! 
She has magnificently achieved the Triple 
Tiara!"

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Daring Tact! 
The pride of Hidaka 
has etched her name into history!!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (Clap, clap, clap, clap...!!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A thundering ovation pours over Daring 
Tact. 
Even without words, the sheer force of 
it... 
conveyed the heartfelt feelings of every 
spectator.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No matter who they had come to support, 
everyone was blessing 
the new queen born here today.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you... so much... 
Thank you all so, so much...!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Incredible!! 
What a tremendous—destiny!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Ah, Tact...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations! 
You're my greatest treasure.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"...She beat me fair and square! 
And with that, the Triple Tiara story 
comes to a close."

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"Still... 
what truly joyous applause, wouldn't you 
say?"

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"I suppose this ending came to pass... 
precisely because she was unwavering in 
being 'Daring Tact.'"

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"Tact, you are the perfect Triple Tiara 
horsegirl— 
truly worthy of this era."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact had accomplished a 
magnificent, historic feat. 
Her figure truly resembled a beacon 
shining through the darkness... 
and the first thing I wanted to tell her 
was—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh? 
You're... thanking me?"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Those words were my own. And at the same 
time— 
I felt I was speaking on behalf of 
everyone 
who had found courage in her run.
choice_data_list:
Thank you for showing us such a wonderful 
dream!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: —Yes!

text_block_list.name: Local Residents
text_block_list.text:
"Tact-chaaan! 
Congratulatiooooons~~~~~!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Whoa...!

text_block_list.name: Local Residents
text_block_list.text:
"Truly, truly... congratulations!" 
"That was an unbelievable run...!" 
"Tact, you're wicked amazing!"

text_block_list.name: Gentle Man
text_block_list.text: "—Tact, you are the pride of Hidaka!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...Ehehe. 
Thank you so much!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"—Umm... 
'T-h-a-n-k- -y-o-u- - 
s-o- -m-u-c-h'...... and send."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...Phew, that's all of them replied to! 
Phew~~..."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A flood of messages had reached Daring 
Tact. 
It showed just how deeply 
she had moved so many hearts.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"I'm all good now. So, about 
our next target race..."
choice_data_list:
You know we can talk about that a bit 
later, right?

We can always talk about that a little 
later, you know?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having just pulled off such an incredible 
triumph, 
one would think she'd want to bask 
in the afterglow for a while...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"No, I want to work 
even harder from here on!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing everyone's smiles today... 
it reaffirmed it for me."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"—I want to show them even bigger dreams 
through my running. 
So this isn't where it ends."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"So, Trainer... 
what race do you have in mind next?"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Truth be told, I had already been thinking 
about it. Having risen 
above the Tiara contenders of her 
generation, the ones 
she should challenge next—are 
higher-caliber opponents.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The absolute pinnacle of competition. 
Because Daring Tact 
is a horsegirl who belongs at that level. 
Which means the goal we must aim for is—
choice_data_list: I want to challenge the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: The "Japan Cup"...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...If it's there, 
I can show everyone an even bigger dream, 
can't I?"
choice_data_list:
Yeah. It's the pinnacle of racing, after 
all.

Yeah, it is the pinnacle of racing, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...Understood. 
Let's take on the Japan Cup!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, our next target race was 
decided... 
The Japan Cup!
choice_data_list: (Now then, who will our opponents be—?)

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: —Huh?! P-Please wait a moment...!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye, what you just said... Please 
say it once more...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Yes! I, Almond Eye, will be entering the 
Japan Cup."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"And while I'm still at my absolute peak, 
I will be stepping away from the front 
lines!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—It was news that came far too suddenly, 
and struck like a bolt from the blue.

title: After the Shuka Sho: A Beacon
